input.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
input.rationale: Section 7(a) caps Contractor's liability at the fees paid for the specific Services under the relevant Statement of Work — a per-SOW, fees-paid-only basis that can fall well below 12 months' fees of the engagement, and below the fallback's mutual 12-month fee cap. More materially, the only carve-out is "CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9", and Paragraph 9 is the Independent Contractor clause (there is no indemnity anywhere in the document, despite the Section 7 caption), so the exception is illusory. The fallback's minimum carve-outs — indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct — are therefore absent, as are IP infringement and fraud; the Section 8 confidentiality obligations and the Section 5(c) non-infringement warranty would all sit inside the fee cap. Section 7(b) does give a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and the Company-side cap at fees paid is favourable to us and left untouched. Redline sets Contractor's cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, replaces the broken cross-reference with a mutual defined set of uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirms our fee payment obligations are not capped damages.

proposal.summary: Raise Contractor's cap to greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 and add mutual uncapped Excluded Claims carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have set Contractor's cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 and replaced the broken cross-reference to Paragraph 9 (which is the independent contractor clause) with a defined set of Excluded Claims, so that indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap for both parties. We have also confirmed that Company's obligation to pay fees due is not treated as capped damages; if helpful, we can accept a straight 12-month fee cap without the USD 1,000,000 floor.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE TO CONTRACTOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000.

ops.oldText: COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR FOR ANY REASON ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR.
ops.newText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS, COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR FOR ANY REASON ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR, AND COMPANY'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES AND EXPENSES PROPERLY DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO SUCH LIMIT. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS.
